text:
sam: Quick question: when a request gets auto-fallbacked, what exact fields do we show in the logs row vs full audit? needs product + ops clarity.
jihoon: We should keep list-row tiny: decision_id, served_route, trigger_short, and sampled_flag. Full audit has inputs, routing graph, timing, and cost_breakdown.
anita: UX idea: list-row pill 'served: fallback' + hover -> tiny panel with: human_reason, lat_delta, cost_hint, and 'open audit' link. show expiry: 'audit link expires in 86d'.
lina: Billing: product insists invoice should reflect billed_on. Proposal: bill on served_model by default, but include attempted_model in audit. product can enable 'bill-on-request' per-account if needed.
ethan: Ops/retention: defaults = meta 90d, full_blob 365d archived on compliance flag or tenant opt-in. Tenants get sample_rate (0.1%-5%) and rollout.override_capture for canaries.
jihoon: API sketch: GET /v1/decisions/{id}?view=meta|full. meta ~200B. meta fields: decision_id, trigger_code, served_route, billed_on, sampled. include short human_reason (<140 chars).
anita: Microcopy variants for message UI: 'Response shortened for latency', 'Content withheld for safety', 'Rerouted to lower-cost variant'. use icon + text so accessible.
ethan: Operator overrides: never mutate original decision. append override_event referencing decision_id with operator_id, timestamp, reason, new_route. CLI: rictl decisions get dec-... --with-overrides
deploy-bot: Deployed: decision-meta-endpoint v1.3 by jihoon — migration: add decision_id index and meta view.
sam: Action items: anita mock the pill + panel, jihoon finalize endpoints + auth, ethan draft retention + sample knobs, lina to confirm billing copy for product. I'll write a short PRD after mocks. Thanks! :thumbsup:
